name: lassu
description: Draw editable diagrams, produce narrated walkthroughs and edit screenshots with Lassu.

interface.longDescription: Draw with your signed-in Lassu app, or connect remotely when no local app is available. Local drawing reuses the app login; remote OAuth is requested only when needed. The desktop app also supports narrated videos and screenshot editing.
defaultPrompt: Draw an editable flowchart with Lassu.
Explain this architecture with a Lassu diagram.
Record a concise narrated demonstration with Lassu.
